Goal: Find the Rule 605 Market Center Files data for July 2024 on fakenyse.com.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-24/
STEP 2: Click "Accept all"
STEP 3: Hover over "Regulation"
STEP 4: Click "Regulatory data files"
STEP 5: Select "Rule 605" in the "Rule" menu
STEP 6: Select "Market Center Files" in the "File type" menu
STEP 7: Select "July" in the "Month" menu
STEP 8: Click "Show files"
STEP 9: Verify "Showing: Rule 605 Market Center Files, July 2024" is visible
